definitions.gloss: giving up without recourse, accepting defeat/loss meekly
definitions.explanation: Accepting an unfair or unjust situation without fighting back or seeking redress, because one feels powerless or sees no way to resolve it. Literally "crying oneself to sleep."

examples.japanese: {泣|な}き{寝入|ねい}り⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧しかなかった。
examples.english: I had no choice but to accept it and move on.

examples.japanese: ⟦{被害者|ひがいしゃ}→被害者：14106_higaisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{泣|な}き{寝入|ねい}り⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{支援|しえん}する→支援する：25534_shiensuru⟧。
examples.english: We provide support so that victims don't have to suffer in silence.

examples.japanese: ⟦{詐欺|さぎ}→詐欺：09789_sagi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遭|あ}って→遭う：09500_au⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{泣|な}き{寝入|ねい}りせず、⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{届|とど}けて→届ける：01248_todokeru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Even if you fall victim to fraud, don't just accept it — report it to the police.

notes:
USAGE:
Typically used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: {泣|な}き{寝入|ねい}り⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to give up without fighting back). Often appears in negative contexts urging people not to accept injustice passively: {泣|な}き{寝入|ねい}り⟦しないで→する：00392_suru⟧ (don't just take it lying down).

The literal image is of crying yourself to sleep — accepting something painful because you feel there is nothing you can do about it.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {泣|な}き{寝入|ねい}り⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to give up without recourse
- {泣|な}き{寝入|ねい}り⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧: to not accept it meekly
- {泣|な}き{寝入|ねい}り⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦しかない→〜しかない：30533_shikanai⟧: to have no choice but to accept it
- {泣|な}き{寝入|ねい}り⟦させない→する：00392_suru⟧: to not let someone suffer in silence
